title: Chapter 1605 - 672: I Am Victorious in This Battle!
content:
Chapter 1605: Chapter 672: I Am Victorious in This Battle!

And the Three-legged Golden Crow screeched, tearing Liang Ming’s Gray Embryo Earth Robe.

The light of the third finger cut across horizontally.

The light of the fourth finger struck down furiously.

The Bone-carrying Child let out a shriek, the broken bones in its arms along with the Flesh Body Jade were blown away by the finger force. The bone fragments exploded into powder, and the child’s small divine body was also torn apart by the golden light, transforming into a cloud of ashes scattering away.

Yet Liang Ming continued to struggle to resist the Three-legged Golden Crow. The Guixu Heart Covering Lid flew up to protect its master, and the Yin Lai Yellow Springs Shovel stood horizontally in front.

The light of the fifth finger pressed down, heavy and resolute!

The Light-Hiding Tomb Woman raised the Broken Lamp to meet it, the mourning garment flapped wildly in the flames.

Boom!

The Light-Hiding Tomb Woman, along with the Magic Power Jade, was extinguished together.

The light of the sixth finger, like a tidal wave.

The Pure Yang Fire Wave rolled out, like a great sun pouring down a sea of golden light and fire.

The Grey Fetus Corpse Mother sprang from the fetal membrane, the Old Official Furi flipped through the Fragmented Volume, both Netherworld Little Gods joined hands at the tomb’s front.

The golden tide pressed down.

The fetal membrane burned through!

The fragmented volume incinerated!

Two divine shadows melted in the fire, collapsing together, like paper in a furnace, turning to ash in an instant.

Chun Yangzi was overwhelmed, his fingertip cracked.

Golden red blood pearls dripped along the finger bones, ignited in the air by the Pure Yang Extreme Certificate Forbidden Technique, turning into tiny sparks floating around Chun Yangzi, fiercely burning.

The seventh finger descended.

The golden light at the fingertip condensed into a line, so bright it made the eyes of watching cultivators sting.

The Erosion Mirror Nether Official’s chest-mounted fragmented mirror reflected, the Earth Belly Fire Swallowing Lord’s damaged belly roared, the Burial Sun Jade Lord’s sleeves turned, three remaining gods joined forces to intercept.

The Erosion Mirror shattered.

The Earth Belly exploded.

The Burial Sun Jade Lord’s dark robe burned fiercely, the state of the seventh tomb directly caved in at one corner.

The other two tombs collapsed completely!

The seal left by the Dusk Sun Body also dissipated at the same time. It had completed its crucial mission, successfully delaying until Chun Yangzi’s comeback.

The seven Yin Tombs were directly reduced to just one new tomb by Chun Yangzi’s final outburst.

The entire plot of Yin soil tossed and turned chaotically, the component elements of the Seven Gui Sacrifice Divine Power were down to almost nothing, resulting in a —

Failed at the finish!

The last Burial Sun Jade Lord was reduced to ashes in the flames.

Thus, all seven Netherworld Little Gods were completely destroyed. The residual Yin Qi instinctively drilled into the ground, then was burned away by the Red Sun Ore Vein like frost melting snow.

The Three-legged Golden Crow’s medicinal power rapidly depleted, running out swiftly, its might no more.

Liang Ming successfully endured, only to suffer retaliatory backlash from the Divine Skills the next moment!

His chest exploded on the spot, blood and soil spurted out several feet.

His Nascent Soul let out a sharp cry, cracks densely covered it, penetrating his entire being, now completely reaching its limit, the whole Nascent Soul shattered to pieces like porcelain hitting the floor.

With the Nascent Soul’s collapse, Liang Ming nearly fainted on the spot, all his cultivation level completely lost!

The audience was dumbfounded, silence reigned.

"So it turns out Chun Yangzi was waiting all along!"

"He held back his attack on purpose, he wanted Liang Ming to reveal his trump card first!"

"Observe clearly, then act. This strategy allowed him to take the initiative. Such courage, such daring, is truly terrifying."

"He deliberately engaged in a six-day-and-six-night battle, patiently waiting for the opponent to be cornered, waiting until the Seven Gui Sacrifice’s trump card was exposed. Skillful and bold, skillful and bold indeed!"

"I was wrong. Previously, Liang Ming seemed mysterious and unpredictable, but now it’s clear the external information greatly underestimated Chun Yangzi’s true combat strength!"

"With this level of combat power, why has the Pure Yang Palace come to this state today?"

"Nonsense. In the Righteous Path, fighting skill alone is not enough. Without managerial talent, the larger the scale, the harder it is to sustain. The Pure Yang Palace has been squeezed out by surrounding forces in recent years, with almost no living space."

Liang Ming collapsed directly on the ground, severely wounded and on the verge of death.

He was filled with resentment and frustration, roaring out loudly: "Chun Yangzi, I have not yet lost, I can still win!"

Divine power backlash, Nascent Soul shattered, flesh body declining.

He reached the brink of life and death, successfully triggering the Heaven-reaching Hook!

At this moment, all sounds on the Dawu Sky Platform seemed to be choked off by an invisible hand.

The Heaven-reaching Hook was activated.

No earth-shattering momentum.

No grand divine light.

There was only a line.

The line was extremely fine, like a spider’s thread, like rain silk, or a cold glimmer hanging down from the depths of fate. It fell from the void, so fine it was nearly invisible, yet made countless cultivators feel their hearts skip, as if a frost blade was pressed to their throats, with their very breath severed in two.

Chun Yangzi’s pupils shrank to the size of needlepoints.

A flash of golden light emerged from his sleeve.

The Yang Fish flew out.

This small golden fish, three inches long, its scales like tiny golden foil, scattered gentle and pure sunlight with its tail movements. Hidden in the depths of its ink jade eyes was a hint of coldness, echoing the principle of extreme Yang giving birth to Yin.

This realm, pursued by Chun Yangzi for many years, had always been unattainable.

However, the Yang Fish was naturally close to the Dao.

It was a spiritual treasure with its own spiritual nature. Before Chun Yangzi could urge it, it had already sensed the murderous intent of the Heaven-reaching Hook.

In an instant, the Yang Fish lashed its tail to meet it, as if throwing itself into the fire.

The golden fish body twisted in mid-air, spilling a sea of pure yang gold. The golden light, like a millennium morning sun accumulated, surged wave after wave toward the hook line like waves crashing upon the shore.

The hook line trembled slightly.

It seemed about to be reversed.

But in the next breath, the hook tip twisted, actually catching the Yang Fish!

The Yang Fish struggled violently, golden scales burst forth with blinding brilliance, exploding fiercely in mid-air.

The tip lightly poked, piercing its radiant splendor.

The small golden fish let out a mournful cry, ultimately unable to withstand the weight of the Taoist Artifact.

The residual power of the hook line persisted, still plunging down toward Chun Yangzi!

Chun Yangzi gritted his teeth, his entire being emptied and powerless.

The Noon Sun Body, previously fused into him, was forcibly separated.

With the separation, Chun Yangzi’s aura plummeted dramatically.

The Noon Sun Body roared and charged, the Pure Yang True Fire burst forth, like a pill furnace exploding, raising a towering wave of golden-white fire in the sky.

The hook tip faced resistance but still pierced through the fire!

The Noon Sun Body’s chest appeared a small hole, as small as a needle piercing paper.

In the next moment, its whole body collapsed like smoke, using all its might, only managing to shave off a small portion of the Taoist Artifact’s leftover power.

The hook tip fell straight towards Chun Yangzi’s forehead, like an arrow piercing the brow.

Chun Yangzi’s face was deathly pale, almost colorless.

At the final moment, a Spiritual Bamboo Puppet shielded Chun Yangzi.

The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard!

It was powerfully mobilized, fearlessly charging up.

It held the void within, covering the falling Heaven-reaching Hook.

The hook plummeted into the void, and then the cultivators saw the Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard crack inch by inch, machinery pieces flying off, like shattered stars shooting randomly.

Ultimately, it was overwhelmed and exploded, shattering to pieces on the spot.

The void exploded, devouring the last hook shadow, and then the reality of heaven and earth swiftly filled the gap, returning to normal.

In the end, it was blocked!

Liang Ming stared wide-eyed, finally fainting from rage upon witnessing this scene.

Chun Yangzi stood still, like a lone peak against the snow.

A thin bloodline slowly slid down his forehead, like a red line tracing a vermilion brush.

Seven black and yellow Gui marks were deeply engraved into his flesh, now emitting cold green smoke.

His finger bones had seven roots, with skin and flesh torn, finger bones shattered, spilling burning hot blood.

His Red Gold Taoist Robe was half-shattered, three thousand scriptures dimmed to ash, like lamps burnt out.

The Golden Crow Carrying Pill Ring had its eyes closed, its spirituality low and weak to the extreme.

Only the Noon Sun Patrol Vehicle remained suspended high. Throughout six days and nights, it had diligently maintained the last geographical advantage of the Dawu Sky Platform for Chun Yangzi. Though it too was battered, its wheels turned slowly, covered with wounds, on the brink of shattering at any moment.

Chun Yangzi suddenly opened his mouth, spitting a mouthful of blood.

He raised his sleeve, slowly wiping the bloodstains from the corner of his mouth.

The motion was very slow.

Extremely difficult.

Chun Yangzi raised his eyes, surveying the numerous cultivators watching the battle.

"This battle."

His voice was hoarse, spread across the Dawu Sky Platform.

"I win!"
